GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased from barrier 10 lengths. well back turn 5 lengths. hooked Wide in Straight . ran on strongly with winner # just missed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure inside the final 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside thus Settled Down 9th 7 Lengths with 1st following 2 Lengths behind, Clear All The Way asked to go at the 400m 6th x 200m 4th x line, Race Suited Swoopers - # had its chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 1 length. joined leader turn. battled away # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. looking for run turn 3 lengths. held up entire Straight # forget
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up from the entrance of the home straight and went to the line without being fully tested. Hampered near the 50m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd & raced 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace & worked to improve =lead Two Wide @ 450m. Pushed along =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & challenged @ 200m. Boxed on honestly but outgunned in last 100m. # On-pace/tried hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was fined the sum of $300 under AR132(7)(a)(ii) for using her whip on nine occasions prior to the 100m, four more times than is permitted under the Rule. Rider was also reprimanded under AR132(7)(a)(i) in that she had also used her whip on three consecutive occasions prior to the 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 10 lengths. well back turn. ran on well # Even Effort
Jumped Fair sat last 6-7l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on well doing best late # best work late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased to last 5 lengths. last turn looking for run. got split 200 metres. ran on strongly # too strong
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced for some distance after the 1200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off all clear, running on half off 200m, took over passing 100m and drew clear # just too good
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 Wide 2 lengths. 3 Wide turn 1 length. weakened # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was bumped on the hindquarter by rnr which shifted out. Raced wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 Wide 2 lengths. Wide turn under pressure 3 lengths. weakened # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 1100m was restrained when tightened. Raced three-wide without cover from the 900m.
